{"query": "promotional credits application to invoice credit ledger usage self serve March bill applied credit", "results": [{"source": "sources/confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/discounting-and-credits-policy-for-usage-based-products.json", "chunk": "9/20", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Discounting and Credits Policy for Usage-Based Products", "status": "published", "date": "2026-02-22", "text": "### Application order (standard)
On each invoice, the billing system applies adjustments in this order:
1. **Included usage** in the customer’s package/free tier (if applicable)
2. **Contracted unit prices** (including any negotiated discount)
3. **Credits** (promotional/contracted/service), applied to the eligible usage subtotal
4. Taxes and non-creditable line items
Important: credits offset charges; they do **not change recorded usage quantities**.
### Cache-hit attribution and billed tokens
If the meter spec distinguishes cached vs uncached billed tokens, credits apply to the final **billed** quantities after cache and dedupe logic. Any customer-visible statement about caching must use approved language from Legal (see related page)."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/discounting-and-credits-policy-for-usage-based-products.json", "chunk": "3/20", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Discounting and Credits Policy for Usage-Based Products", "status": "published", "date": "2026-02-22", "text": "## Definitions (use these terms consistently)
- **Meter / billable unit:** The unit recorded by billing telemetry and used to produce invoices. Example: **billed_tokens** for Hosted API.
- **Raw tokens vs billed tokens:** Raw tokens may include uncached or pre-dedupe counts. **Billed tokens** are the invoicing unit after billing rules (dedupe/idempotency, cache-hit attribution rules, etc.). Credits and discounts apply to **billed** usage only.
- **Discount:** A reduction in price per unit (e.g., $/1M tokens) or a percentage reduction on usage charges.
- **Credit:** A dollar value that offsets charges on invoices (a “coupon” balance). Credits have **no cash value** and are not refundable unless required by contract or law.
- **Service credit:** A credit issued for SLA/non-conformance or billing errors.
- **Promotional credit:** A credit granted for trial, marketing campaigns, partnerships, or sales incentives.
- **Contracted credit:** A credit explicitly included in an Order Form/MSA as part of commercial terms."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/hosted-api-packages-free-tier-and-overage-policy.json", "chunk": "10/16", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Hosted API Packages: Free Tier, Included Usage, and Overage Policy", "status": "published", "date": "2026-02-26", "text": "### Customer notifications
Minimum notification set (must be enabled for all paid workspaces):
- 80% included usage (warning)
- 100% included usage (soft limit)
- 110% included usage (approaching hard limit)
- Invoice preview available (see month-end preview process)
---
## Credits, refunds, and disputes (packaging interaction)
### Credits application order
Unless an order form specifies otherwise:
1) Included usage
2) Promotional or sales-issued credits
3) Overage charges
### Refunds/credits policy (high level)
- Billing disputes are governed by the dispute window in the MSA/order form.
- Any retroactive adjustment impacting recognized revenue requires Finance approval and must be documented with an audit trail.
- Support may issue customer goodwill credits only per the approvals matrix in the Discounts/Credits policy.

Support confirmed customer approval on 2026-03-12.
